scores.name: tool_selection
scores.rubric: Score 1.0 when the tool description makes it obvious to call get_weather for current weather, forecasts, temperatures, precipitation, or conditions, and obvious not to call it for unrelated questions. Penalize vague descriptions or missing disambiguation guidance.

scores.name: parameter_quality
scores.rubric: Score 1.0 when the input schema is minimal, clearly named, typed, required where necessary, includes useful descriptions/examples, supports location and units/time-window needs, and avoids redundant or confusing parameters.

scores.name: output_quality
scores.rubric: Score 1.0 when the output schema clearly tells the model how to interpret weather results, including units, timestamp/freshness, resolved location, conditions, and uncertainty or error fields. Penalize underspecified numeric or string fields.

scores.name: conciseness
scores.rubric: Score 1.0 when the description and schemas are compact and specific. Penalize generic prose, repeated wording, unnecessary fields, or descriptions that are much longer than needed.
